title: 3EN002 read-only SSH audit
description: Read-only SSH audit of OpenWrt router 3EN002 at 192.168.1.2. Collects board/system identity, network and firewall UCI, addresses, routes, DHCP/DNS config, DNS state, recent system log, and banIP status. No configuration changes are made. SSH is non-interactive and timeout-protected so the agent cannot hang waiting for credentials.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $HostIp='192.168.1.2'; $User='root'; Write-Host '=== 3EN002 OPENWRT SSH AUDIT 010 ==='; Write-Host ('Time='+(Get-Date -Format o)); Write-Host ('Target='+$User+'@'+$HostIp); Write-Host ''; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if(-not $ssh){ Write-Host 'SSH_CLIENT=FAIL ssh.exe not found'; exit 20 }; Write-Host ('SSH_CLIENT='+$ssh.Source); $remote='echo === SYSTEM ===; ubus call system board 2>/dev/null || true; echo; echo === UCI_NETWORK ===; uci show network 2>&1; echo; echo === UCI_FIREWALL ===; uci show firewall 2>&1; echo; echo === IP_ADDR ===; ip addr 2>&1; echo; echo === IP_ROUTE ===; ip route 2>&1; echo; echo === DHCP_CONFIG ===; cat /etc/config/dhcp 2>&1; echo; echo === DNS_RUNTIME ===; cat /tmp/resolv.conf.d/resolv.conf.auto 2>/dev/null || cat /tmp/resolv.conf.auto 2>/dev/null || true; echo; echo === FIREWALL_RUNTIME ===; nft list ruleset 2>/dev/null | head -n 220 || true; echo; echo === BANIP_STATUS ===; if command -v banip-status >/dev/null 2>&1; then banip-status 2>&1; elif [ -x /etc/init.d/banip ]; then /etc/init.d/banip status 2>&1; else echo BANIP_NOT_INSTALLED_OR_NO_STATUS_COMMAND; fi; echo; echo === LOGREAD_LAST_300 ===; logread -l 300 2>&1 || logread 2>&1 | tail -n 300; echo; echo === AUDIT_END ==='; Write-Host '--- SSH BEGIN ---'; & $ssh.Source -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 -o ConnectionAttempts=1 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=1 ($User+'@'+$HostIp) $remote 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Host '--- SSH END ---'; Write-Host ('SSH_EXIT_CODE='+$rc); if($rc -eq 0){Write-Host 'SSH_AUDIT=PASS'}else{Write-Host 'SSH_AUDIT=FAIL'; Write-Host 'HINT=If authentication failed, configure SSH key authentication for root@192.168.1.2; BatchMode intentionally prevents password prompts.'; exit $rc}
test: if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){Write-Host 'OPENWRT SSH AUDIT 010 COLLECTION PASS'}else{Write-Host ('OPENWRT SSH AUDIT 010 COLLECTION FAILED rc='+$LASTEXITCODE)}
